objective: Determine whether serializing the complete convolution-plus-delta GDN state transaction repairs the exact two-request failure after neither isolated R80 stage was sufficient.
decision: The combined state transaction is implicated only if both requests complete 128 tokens, both exactly match the R72 token oracle, cached_tokens are both zero, both R80 stage markers appear on both TP ranks, and no new GPU/Xe/OOM fault occurs.
promotion_boundary: A pass is a diagnostic repair candidate, not a public speed or quality result. It must subsequently pass the clean-boot varied-prompt, deterministic-repeat, context-depth, concurrency, and speed-floor gates.
